_help: Composer edits applied on top of the automatically derived cue plan (audio/music.py) every time the plan is derived, so they survive screenplay revisions. Keys: a scene id ('s02') = the cue that starts with that scene; 'sXX:mood' = the cue of that mood containing the scene. Values: any cue field (from, to, mood, key, bpm, intensity, ramp, transition_in, ending, melody_stem, layers_off, gain_db, prog, hits) or 'hits+' to append hits to the cue containing the scene. Hits: {t | sfx+scene(+offset), kind: sting|stop|swell|wahwah|tada|creep|pluck|ping, len | until, stab, notes}. Missing beat references are skipped with a warning. Editing this file re-derives data/music_plan.json (the previous plan is kept as a timestamped backup).
